executedBy: root only, after review; NOT executed by Claude

creates: one launcher (node) in its own session/process group
one QEMU (SNP guest) via qemu-restrict.sh exec
process.signals: only the launcher process group while an owned (pid,starttime) member is alive in it; only the run's own scope via systemctl --user stop

memory.queueLanes: both taken exclusively, non-blocking (98 if busy)

disk.private: runs/<stamp>/private 0700: fw_cfg (0600), test pairing key, host config, collateral copy - removed by the child, or by the parent after proven absence

network.guest: slirp restrict=on: no host (10.0.2.2) and no outside address; one hostfwd 127.0.0.1:<ephemeral> -> guest 8444 (attested control front)

host.kds: --kds on (default): AMD KDS GETs only if the cached collateral lacks/needs refresh; off: none
host.registry: --registry on (default): read-only eth_call of the original EnclaveRegistry through https://base-rpc.publicnode.com + https://mainnet.base.org; off: none

created: a random 32-byte test pairing key (private/, 0600, deleted; redacted from the sanitized serial log)

production.guestd: never contacted (refused stand-in ports + restricted net)

limits: bare direct control only: no MCP/Platform API/apps/registration
host node v22 runs the verifier; the guest runs the image's own runtime
